messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error from suggest.buffer
parts:
Hello there
I can't say specifically what might be going wrong. The average distance between detectors cannot really be 2 metres, surely? Have you plotted the capthist? It's generally better to specify detectpar, but the guess based on autoini is somewhat plausible, so that is unlikely to be the reason for the error. Send the capthist to me offline if you can't figure it out (save the capthist using saveRDS(capthistW, file = 'capthistW.RDS')).
Murray
P.S. you probably need detector type 'proximity' rather than 'multi'.

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error from suggest.buffer
parts:
Examining your capthistW (received offline - thanks) I see that for each session (years 2019, 2021?) the traps object is the same and includes twice as many detectors as actually used in either year. As most locations matched in the two years, each detector appears to have a very close neighbor. This leads to the 2-m mean distance-to-nearest-other-detector, which in turn trips up the ad hoc algorithm in suggest.buffer() (and causes it to take an awfully long time). The solution is to provide the detector locations as two separate input files, one per session. Then the number of detectors per session will halve to 66.

I hope this helps.
Murray
